tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi nī sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ rdo rje

stong pa rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa ni/ ma'i mo rtags 'dzin pa/ sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po re zhig rnal bdag nyid lha'i 'byor pas dang po thun tha ma la nyal lugs gang yang rung ba'i nyal 1 ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ de nas gnyis pa tho rangs ḍā ma ru'i sgras bskul te sdang 2 ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ de nas gsum pa bdud rtsi myong 3 ba'i rnal 'byor byas la phyi rol gyi mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i dus su rnal 'byor ba'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal bya/ 'di phyi mchod dang 'brel bas 'dir mi dgos so// bzhi pa tshad med 4 pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bde ba la dgod par bya'o/ sems bskyed gcig la bzhi ka tshang*/ /zhes tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor sngon du bya'o// de nas lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi bla ma spyi bor bsgom par bya'o// de'i rjes la drug pa bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams la/ der/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba lugs las bzlog par bsam mo// dbus ni bam̐ dmar po/ yig go /de'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus khyab pa rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa/ yongs su dag pa na/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i sku zhal gcig de bzhin nyid kyi rtags/ phyag gnyis pa/ bden pa gnyis kyi rtags/ sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ thugs rje'i rtags/ phyag rgya lnga'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i rten/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang chos 'byung gi nang du 'khor ba la mi gnas pa'i rtags/ nyi ma'i gdan la khro mo mtshon pas/

g.yon bskums pas 'jig byed dang*/ g.yas brkyangs pa dus mtshan zhabs kyis mnan pa/ g.yas na rdo rje pad+mas mtshan pa'am 'dam ka yin gsungs te ḍā ma ru dang bcas pa gang rung 'dzin par bsam/ dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang bde ba chen po byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga mtshan khung du phrag par bkal ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ de nas slar yang brgyad pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor/ yig 'bru'i tshogs kyi 'od zer gyis dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad dang sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur byas la/ spyan drangs te bdag nyid la gzhug par bya'o// bdun pa/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba 'di sngon la byas la de nas dus gcig tu bsdu gsungs/ thams cad dag par byas nas rje btsun ma'i skur bskyed la/ slar log ste sngags kyi phreng ba nyid la zhugs pa dang*/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor yid ngag gi dbye bas bzla bar bya'o// de ltar yid bzlas byed na 'dom du chos 'byung bsam/ de la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ de nas rlung bsdoms te de la dmigs 'dun bya/ rgod na yid bzlas bya/ de la skyo na ngag bzlas bya/ ngag gi bzlas pa 'ba' zhig byed na snying gar gtod par bya gsungs so// de nas bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bam̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis sa gsum dang lus dang*/ yi ge rim gyis nā da stong par bsam/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa sngon du 'gro bas de kho na nyid bsgom par bya'o// bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni thun mtshams su rgyan dang phyag mtshan med par byas la bya ba thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// phyi mchod kyang bya'o// thun tha ma la seng ge'i khri'i steng du nyal bar bsams la bla ma steng gi thad kar bltas te phyag byed par bsams la nyal/ bskyed rim la mos pa che na de ltar bya/

de lta min na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal lo// las dang po pa'i bsgom pa mdor bsdus pa slob dpon nā ro ta pa'i zhal gyi gdams ngag brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti'i zhal snga nas dang*/ dge bsnyen pradzñā kīrtis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ rnam kun mchog ldan shes rab lha mo dang*// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen mo la btud de// rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams len bshad kyi nyon// 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rung thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ nub mo 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal/ tho rangs ldang ba'i tshe nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su grags pas bskul te/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur gyur pa bsams la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod dam bdud rtsi ril bu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas myangs te snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod par bsam/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci mang brjod/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/

de'i phyir du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma de rang la thim pas/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor gyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad gang bas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung ste zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyangs bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pa rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa tshur 'dus te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su g.yon du bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ pad kor dang bcas pa'i 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ yo ga shad+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma dam bca' ji tsam yod pa las mi nyung bar bzla/ mthar snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar phab la rlung kha sbyar te/ chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtad cing sngags kyi yi ge 'bru g.yon skor du gnas pa la yid kyis lan bdun bklag

lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gyur te/ gzugs med khams pa lus kyi bstod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams pa bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams pa smad kyi cha la/ rang gi sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis 'dus te chos 'byung la/ chos 'byung zla ba la/ zla ba sngags phreng la/ sngags phreng bam̐ yig la/ bam̐ yig mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da'ang mi dmigs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ ldang ba'i tshe rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag dang 'da' kha ma'i gdams ngag yod na 'dir bsgoms la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo glu dbyangs sil snyan sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de chos gsung yang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des kyang lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces sogs smon lam ci shes gdab/ spyod lam gyi tshe rang dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku/ grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sngags/ sems kyi dran rigs thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings las ma g.yos par shes pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dga' ba gsum dang ma bral bar bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā nā ya hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam lngas phul/ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang 'bru gsum brjod cing nang bdud rtsis kyang mchod la/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul na skabs 'dir phul la/ rjes chog kyang spyi dang mthun par bya'o// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul 'di'ang don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ ngag 'don rnams bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dka' bzang po'i gsung rab gzhir bzhag rnal 'byor lhag ma rnams dpal sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab nas kha bskangs te/ nyams su blang bde bar btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /brgyud 'debs ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro ta pa pham mthing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/

kha skong ni/ kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams seng ge sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// bud+dha siṃ hā rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ 'di yan nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad/ 'phros rnams gsar ngu bris pa'o// nam mkha' dpal bzang bsod nams lhun grub dang*// kun dga' bkra shis shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dam chos bsam 'grub dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bkra shis lhun grub bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// dpal ldan chos skyong rin chen mchog grub zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes so// bskyed rim zab mo'i mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dang*// rdzogs rim dbu ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i mthus// bde chen lhan skyes ye shes skye ba dang*// mkha' spyod go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// nā ro ta pa'i man ngag gi nye brgyud la gsol ba 'debs pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ bla ma yi dam dbyer med dang*// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// byin rlabs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul// cho ga'i rim pa cung zad 'bri// de la 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ bla chen 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge las rtogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ sum+bha sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol mo dang ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi sogs gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur par bsam/ ldang ba'i tshe rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang zhes pa'i bar rje btsun rat+na ni ra bho gas mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar bya'o// mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ kam̐ las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ e yig nyis brtsegs las byung ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i tha mar sogs nas zhes pas bskor te gnas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sogs nas shud+dho3 haṃ/ mchod pa byin rlabs snga ma ltar las shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi nī kun la sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ rol chen dang ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ rū pa sogs nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te aḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs phyag rgyar bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nang mchod gtor/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// grub chen nā ro pa dang pham 'thing pa// shes rab brtsegs dang mal lo sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje brag phug pa// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun dga' bzang po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*// bsod nams seng ge sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs// lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// bud+dha siṃ ha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs dang*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud sogs nas/ ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par bya'o// 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi rang gi lce la myong ngo*// na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs nas swā hās yid mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang sogs nas ha ho hrīḥ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su oṃ a kā ro sogs nas phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtor chog ltar phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bde mchog ltar bya'o// de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/

zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i chu'i dbus su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas sogs nas thim zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar brjod mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol chen dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags nas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod/ dpal ldan sogs kyis bstod/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bum nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zag pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ sum+bha dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs bzla/ slar yang mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ 'dod don gsol gdab dang*/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal me tog bum pa dang bcas pa sta gon byas te byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa nas brtsams te spyad du gsol gyi bar slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gtor ma skabs 'dir phul kyang rung bas gang bde bya chog go /gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba la/ bde mchog lū nag sogs gang rung gi dbang thob pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa nang gshim pa rnams khrus byas nas g.yon skor tu gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/

slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam par byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i byin rlabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam bzhugs pa'i nang tshan/ gtso bor mchog sgrub pa la dmar mo skor gsum dang*/ las rgyas pa la dmar po skor gsum dang gnyis las/ 'dir dmar mo skor gsum gyi phyogs yin/ de la'ang rje btsun nā ro ta pas bde mchog le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa la brten nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang lam gyi cha rkyen la sogs pa mdzad de/ de rnams la nā ro mkha' spyod ces grags so// yang rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū tis rgyud de nyid la brten nas phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ sngags btu la sogs pa'i gdams pa dang bcas mdzad pa rnams la in+d+ra mkha' spyod ces yongs su grags pa dang*/ yang grub chen mai tri pas rgyud ral pa gyen brdzes la brten nas rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas mdzad pa la mai tri mkha' spyod ces grags pa rnams su yod pa las 'dir grub chen nā ro pa'i phyogs la brten pa yin/ de la'ang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi cha rkyen pra se nā dbab pa dang*/ laṅka lī ya la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs zab mo sgrub par byed pa yin/ de la gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/

'khor lo bde mchog lū nag sogs gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ 'di'i byin rlabs thob cing chag med rgyun du byed pa zhig dgos/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ dbang thob cing byin rlabs don du gnyer ba dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom byed pa'i slob ma zhig la bstan par bya ba yin la/ nam bya ba'i dus ni rtsa rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces gsungs pas gtso bor 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa la mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ mthun rkyen bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog par byed pa la yar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis yod pa las/ da lan yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i skabs su babs pa yin/ de las gzhan pa'i tshes grangs la mi bya ste/ dus tshes ma dag par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba la/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon tu 'gro ba'i sgo nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod bstod bya ba/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ bum pa sgrub pa/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i byin rlabs thams cad slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang dgos pa rnams sngon du legs par grub zin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ zhugs nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

nas/ 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcings nas/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong du mjal du mi btub pas u dum wā ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng bar byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba gtad la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyed rang rnams la byin gyis brlab pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi khyed rang rnams kyi ljags thog dang sku la gtor te bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing de ltar lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang zhing zag med kyi bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas sems bskyed pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu skya chil bar gsal btab la/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gyen du langs par byung bar mos te/ bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa dā yā mi zhes brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni mgo bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ nang 'jug gi slad du slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas mgo dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid nas shar du 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi pha mas thog drangs mkha' mnyam gyis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ ces rgyud dag par byas nas mdor na rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs gsum/ zhes pas sdom pa thams cad tshul bzhin du bzung nas/ slar yang de dag gi spyan sngar dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gzung*// zhes dam tshig bzung ba dang bcas pa ni sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis bcom ldan das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab par gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig sogs nas/ swā hā zhes pa dmar khyil gyis 'khor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de las 'od zer 'phros snod thams cad la phog pas yongs su dag pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer de rnams tshur 'dus te khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim par mos pa mdzod/

de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo ste go cha rnams kyang ngo bo lha yin pa la rnam pa yig 'bru'i gzugs su gsal lam gyis btab nas/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i dngos grub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song bas lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can gsal lam par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma brjod cing ting lo sbyin/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bde ba chen pos yongs su gang bas lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bde ba chen po'i gar stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur pas khyed rang rnams kyi thugs rgyud la bde stong gi ye shes skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ lte ba'i nang gi chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/

slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad kar dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du dmar khyil gyis 'khor ba la sems gtad pas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' skor gyi sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ chos 'byung gi dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams la dus cig tu shes pa gtad pas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skyes par mos pa mdzod/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi na bzhugs pa thams cad thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar gnyis su med par thim par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams sogs nas/ thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis ḍā dril rol mo sogs dang*/ ngag tu oṃ gsum ma brjod/ ces pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ de ltar byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya ba'i phyir du rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor ba ni 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ rim pa ltar byon nas g.yon pa'i phyag gis me tog de rje btsun ma'i dbu la phul bar mos te/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing me tog dor ba zhu/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la oṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog dang mig ras lhan cig tu phyes nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te 'og gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni kun rdzob brdar btags pa'i dkyil 'khor brda'am mtshan ma tsam yin la/ de'i steng du 'byung bzhi ri rab kyi steng du thod pa dkar po shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas sogs nas bzhugs pa ste/ mdor na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gdos bcas kyi rnam pa ma yin par me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum lta bur gzigs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

des 'jug pa'i cho ga grub nas/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /lan gsum/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru gsum gyi sar/ rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can re rer gsal bar gyur pa'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ phaiṃ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ ces spyan drangs te/ dbang gi lhas mdun gyi nam mkha'i ltos thams cad khyab nas bzhugs par mos par byas te/ khyed rnams kyi phyogs su bum pa cung zad yo ba dang bcas pas me tog gi char dbab cing bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis gang zhig ces sogs sh+lo ka gsum bya/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha'i gtso mo rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rigs lngas bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyi glu len/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos par mdzod/ slob dpon gyis bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ngag tu ji ltar bltams pa nas shri ye hūm̐ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu rab tu gnas par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs dang me tog spyi bor bzhag go /des rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba yin/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba bye ru bstar la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs thams cad sngags kyi phreng ba'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ zhal nas 'thon pa'i sngags phreng dang dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid khyed rnams rje btsun ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mtha' nas phar g.yas skor du dmar khyil gyis 'khod par mos pa byas nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos te slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum/ khyed rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba yin/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du nyin re bzhin la sngags ji tsam bzla ba'i dam bca' khas len du bcug la/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyin re bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chag par dam bca' snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung zhing de'i gsang sngags oṃ gsum ma nyi ma re re bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ma chag par 'don par dam 'cha' lags so// de rnams brtan pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis g.yon pas srin lag gis sin+dhū ra'i rdul tshon blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis ngag tu oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bha ga nas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/

maṇ+ḍal gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ zhes byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas myang bas bdud rtsi des lus thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags rim 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mos nas de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos par mdzod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sin+dhū ra'i rdul tshon blangs te/ khyed rnams kyi dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsang gnas rnams su yas rim gyis reg pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang bskur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams thabs shes rab snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa de khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i bha ga'i nang nas zhugs te lus thams cad la khyab pas rim pa bzhin lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ lte ba nas snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ snying ga nas mgrin par byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ mgrin pa nas spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos par byas te/ lus thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis khyab pas nyams myong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid nga yin no zhes pa'i don yin no// de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul du thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i zhal nas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs pa'i don nyams su len par byed pa la/ lus bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag sems kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul tsam du thag bcad/ rang lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i phyag rgya la mnyam par sbyar ba dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i 'dzag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ba de yid yul byas te/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe skye 'gag gnas pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis stong pa nam mkha' lta bu ste/ nam mkha' la skye 'gag med pa bzhin sems la skye 'gag med/ nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong med pa bzhin sems la 'gro 'ong med/ nam mkha' la rtag chad med pa bzhin sems la rtag chad med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin sems la mtha' dbus med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba bzhin sems la glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi brdzi/ nam mkhas phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab pa ltar/ sems kyis 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyab pa ste/ mdor na spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo lhod kyis klod nas sems la sems kyis lta ba'i tshul gyis gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

de ltar dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des dngos gzhi grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su sogs rjes kyi chos gsum gzhan dang 'dra'o// des rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs zab mo gsan pa yin pas do nub nas bzung ste chag med la sogs par brtson pa dang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon gyis bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang nas phyi nang gi mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod pa'i bar bum bskyed ltar ro// ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas badz+ra muḥ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐ sogs kyis bsrung ngo*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs bsngo smon/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyi bkra shis bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor dang chos ldan gyi bya ba sogs la 'jug go /zhes pa 'di ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yig char mi gsal ba rnams kyi gsal byed du bdag gi bla mas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub la sogs pa'i mkhas grub rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa brang ti pa dge slong nam mkha' dpal bzang gis e wam̐ thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o// slar yang phyi mo la mchan dkyus su shor ba sogs yig nor rgyun 'byams rigs cung zad dag par bgyis shing*/

byin rlabs kyi skabs 'phags pa rin po che'i yig char zhal 'phang mdzad pa 'ga' zhig phyogs 'dir zhal 'dris med pa'i las dang po pa la phan par bsams nas dkyus su bris pa dge/ 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi zur 'debs nyung gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī pā dā ya/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs bya tshul mthong ba don ldan gyi zur 'debs cung zad brjod pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis gang yang rung ba'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ gnas dben par stegs bu'i dbus su maṇ+ḍa lar rdul tshon gyi chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang thams cad tshon dmar po/ phyi rol gyi bar thams cad ljang gu/ bcad dkar po/ dbus su zla gdan la tshon phung dmar po bkod pa ni sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dar ram ras dmar pos bkab pa ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du me long la sin+dhū ra bkram par/ gser gyi thur ma'am rdo rje'i rtses chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi/ dbus su bam̐/ de'i mthar mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba bris te bshams pa ni thugs sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor ro// de'i mdun sogs gang bder ting lo chung ngu 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba dang*/ steng du dar dmar ram lwa dmar lta bu'i gur khang mdzes par phub pa'i mthar shar lhor mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang*/ shar du mchod yon sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yon skor/ shar lho nas byang shar gyi bar du gtor ma gnyis sam gsum/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/

ḍā ma ru/ bum pa bcud ldan/ maṇ+ḍal/ nye logs ci bde bar sngon 'gro gtor ma/ slob ma la dgos pa'i mig dar/ me tog ting lo sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad legs par 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab kyis bran/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas bskor zhing phaiṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥsogs kyis spyan drangs la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing nang mchod srin lag gis gtor la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rjes btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du srung zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ ces dang*/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig

sum+bha sogs brjod cing rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol la gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dmigs te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyis phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ so so'i sngags rgya sogs dkyus bzhin las/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs sems kyi rjes/ spro na rdor sems he ru ka'i sgom bzlas ma rgyud spyi ltar bya/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas brtsams te bdag bskyed rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs pa'i mthar/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur ces pa'i rjes/ slar yang rang skad cig gis rjes btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang*/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gnyis char la dmigs te bsang sbyang rgyas par spro na bde mchog gi nang mchod byin rlabs ltar bya'am/ de tsam ma grub na sgrub thabs kyi mjug gi gtor ma ltar byin brlab/ de nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod blang*/ dkyil 'khor gsum char la gtor te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung sogs nas/ yo ga shud+dho3haṃ zhes pa'i bar byin rlabs kyi dkyus ltar/

mchod pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun sogs byin rlabs kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar byin brlab/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta mi dgos/ de nas mdun bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i steng gi char brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor du skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin tu bzhugs par bsams la/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas rgyas par spro na phyi mchod chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ gos zung*/ rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid bdun/ 'dod yon lnga rnams tshigs bcad dang sngags spel bas spyi ltar 'bul/ bsdu na nyer spyod dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dkyus su gsal ba ltar gyis mthus/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod g.yon pa'i srin lag gis thog mar spyi gtsug nas 'thor zhing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs nas/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang chen sogs nas/ siṃ ha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nam mkha' dpal bzang bsod nams lhun grub dang*// kun dga' bkra shis shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan dam chos bsam grub dang*// sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bkra shis lhun grub bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// dpal ldan chos skyong rin chen mchog grub zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ snying ga'i thad nas gtor te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= /gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nams kyi zhal du=

/de nas rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ skabs 'dir gtor ma la bar phud bran la lte ba'i thad nas gtor te/ de nas oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor bsrung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du= /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan+do dang nye ba'i tshan+do/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du= zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du= gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byad/ rjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du= bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba sogs lan gsum brjod do// dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod cing se gol brdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā ka shā ya sa man+ta māṃ/ sarba ta tha ga ta a pa ri sho dhā ya/ maṇ+ḍa le ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dzñā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+ta/ ban+dha swa s+thā na ba le na tsā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing se gol lan gnyis brdab pa ni yid byung gi mchod pa'o// bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hī bam̐ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bid+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni sho ṣa ni ro ṣa ni krodhi ka rā li nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo s+t+ra sa ni mā ra ṇi su pra bhai da ni a pa rā dzā ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī bam̐ ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ rgyas par spro na/

ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin sogs ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'ang bya/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dkyus su 'dir 'bul bar gsungs kyang bdag 'jug gi rjes su 'bul ba stabs bde bas phyag len la de ltar mdzad/ bum pa dkyus ltar bsgrub/ bdag 'jug ni/ rang gi mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang me tog sogs bsham/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bum chus khrus bya/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'i mthar/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du sogs me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ gang gi drin gyis sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis gdong bcings shing*/ me tog gi phreng ba blang bar mos/ mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hī'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te rang nyid la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ sum+bha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi myong bas nang rtsa khams kyi bar chad thams cad sbyangs shing bde ba chen pos byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ sarba sogs/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sogs kyis bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed cing brtan par mos/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod sogs/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la mgo dud tsam dang bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang nyid sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod par mos te/

mdun bskyed tshogs zhing rgya mtshos bskor ba'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags/ sdom bzung*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bzung ba rnams so sor lan gsum re bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te rang gi lte ba'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig sogs nas zhes pas dmar khyil gyis bskor bar gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus te lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes sogs nas tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo zhes brjod nas slob dpon khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub rnams stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo rje btsun ma'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis byung ste rang gi zhal du zhugs/ mgrin pa dang snying ga nas dmar hril gyis song ba lte ba'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig la thim pa de yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku ru gyur/ des lus kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir bde ba'i gar stabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgyur ba dang*/

nang gi chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi dang*/ phyi'i smin mtshams kyi thad rnams su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon phyogs su 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra sbyar/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bzhag cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ me tog gi phreng ba rje btsun mar phul ba'i mos pas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod cing dor ba'i tshul bya/ slar yang spyi bor bzhag par mos te/ oṃ pra tī gṛh+na sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs brjod la mig dar dbye ba'i tshul bya/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams pa rnams ni 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi'i dbang gi slad du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i chos rnams sogs/ thal mo sbyar te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku can du gsal ba'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bas/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ rdor dril 'dzin pas me tog gtor zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs nas/ bden pas des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/ces brjod nas/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang thams cad thob/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lhas/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hās spyi bor me tog bzhag par bsam/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags kyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs sa bon gyi mthar g.yon skor du 'khod par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum bzla/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum brjod cing me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag sin+dhū ra'i rdul tshon gnas gsum du reg pas byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par mos te oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang sogs nas/ rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// gsang dbang gi slad du/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i mkha' gsang nas byang sems dkar dmar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pa de nyid rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rags rim dbyings su 'gags pa'i gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par mos/ de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis rang gi gnas bzhir reg pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i mkha' gsang nas zhugs te/ gnas bzhir drangs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos te 'khyud rgya dang bcas pas/

oṃ sarba sogs brjod/ de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ mdun gyi rje btsun mas gsungs par bsams la/ dngos po med pa'i nas/ bsgom zhes brjod cing de'i don bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par gzhag de ltar na dbang bzhi pa sogs nas/ bzhag pa yin no// gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi nas/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu dbul bar sogs dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin brlabs la/ sgrub thabs ltar 'bul zhing 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa chos skyong gi gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi tshogs 'bul/ bsdu na chos srung la logs su ma phul kyang rung*/ de nas slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni byin rlabs kyi dkyus su gsal ba ltar ma 'khrul bar bgyis pas grub/ gsum pa rjes ni/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i dkyus ltar la/ bkra shis ni tshigs bcad kyi mtshams su dril bu gsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung bas// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas bde legs su bya zhing*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o// skabs gzhan tu sgrub mchod rgyas par bya bar 'dod na'ang cho ga'i 'gros spyir gong ltar la/

mchod phreng dang*/ bstod pa sogs kha 'phangs su byas pa rnams sbyar ba tsam gyis legs par grub pa yin no// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed na/ tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu dang*/ sgrib pa sbyong ba la mar ngo'i tshes bcur/ sbyor ba'i skabs gzhan 'dra ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi nye logs gang bder ma da na dang*/

chang*/ sha bā la gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i yo byad ci 'byor pa gtsang zhing bkod pas mdzes par bsham/ dngos gzhi bdag 'jug gtor bsngo yan legs par grub nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs gtor ma ltar bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha hoḥhrīḥlan mang du brjod pas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa nan tan tu bya/ de nas phud snod gtsang mar blugs la dkyil 'khor gyi mdun tu bzhag gtor ma rnams la'ang phul/ slar yang bdud rtsis bran/ gang gi drin gyis sogs bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam lngas yi dam dang*/ chos skyong la so so'i gtor sngags sam/ bsdu na/ oṃ shrī badz+ra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs lan gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags kyis phul/ tshogs pa yod na zhu 'bul spyi ltar dang bcas bza' btung gi tshogs rnams rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mdun du bstar/ spro na ma da na bdud rtsir bsam pa'i phud/ rdo rje 'chang chen sogs kyis nang mchod kyi skabs ltar 'bul/ gang ltar yang snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mchod par bsams la/ a ho su kha zhes brjod cing lag g.yon pas blangs te zhen pa med par longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya byas pa'i bar nas/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod pa dang bstun/ ma da na'i kha phru gdab/ slar yang nang mchod chu chang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba len+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin pas 'byung po thams cad tshims par bsams la/ mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar dang bcas lam gyi gzhi mdor dor/ shes na brtag gnyis las 'byung ba'i kol+la i reṭa ṭha sogs kyi rdo rje'i glu'am/

bde mchog las gsungs pa'i dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu blang*/ gang ltar yang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ bkra shis gang zhig sogs kyi mthar/ 'chi tshe mgon dang sogs smon lam gang shes gdab/ de nas rjes chog dkyus ltar bya'o// sbyin sreg gi cho ga ni paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung rab ltar la/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i slad du mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ kong bu yangs par ras dmar gyi ldong bu sbom po btsugs/ mar dkar gyi khu bas dgang*/ de'i mdun tu 'byor na zlum gtor gcig dang*/ mchod pa lnga bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya'am/ thun mtshams kyi lha rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dran pa tsam gyis kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang mar me sbar la/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bam̐ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ phaiṃ/ thugs ka'i nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim zhes bya ba'i bar gyis gsal gdab/ de nas mdun du bsreg rdzas til nag po bzhag la/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sna sgo nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas thon te mdun gyi til la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur ba de nyid rje btsun ma'i zhal du phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsams la mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar/ sarba pā paṃ sogs btegs pa gang yang rung bas mar me ma zad bar du phul/ mar me zad par brtsams pa na mchod gtor yod na oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar phul/

gang ltar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ bsngo smon shis brjod dkyus ltar byas la/ mar me'i ro ma chu bo chen po'am gtsang sar dor ro// 'di ni sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs khyad par can yin par gsungs so// gzhan yang lam gyi cha rkyen pra se nā dbab pa sogs las tshogs phra mo rnams ni deng sang lag len tu 'debs mkhan nyung bas 'dir ma bris te/ rtogs par 'dod na yig rnying sogs las shes par bya'o// zhes mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug thar rtse paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i zhabs tog tu dmigs te/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab da nga*/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub kyi zur 'debs sogs kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar mdor bsdus snying por dril ba'i tshul gyis bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mchog la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dā ka l+ya ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dad pa'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags can skyes bu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi dbang gyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas par de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyong phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen mo'i go 'phang thob par shog

/mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma dpal la// bstod pa'i tshig 'di bshes gnyen dam pa 'gas// yang yang bskul nas dge slong rgyud gsum pas/ kun dga' bzang po/ /mkhas pa'i chos grwa dpal ldan sa skyar bris// ༈ /rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs nyung gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/ dbang dang byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i slad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben cing yid dang mthun la rang dbang 'dus pa'i sar/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu lta bu'i dus khyad par can gyi snga dro'i char gnas khang phyag dar bya/ go yul gyis bde na rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa'i mal stan bshams pa'i 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'i lte bar 'bru dkar dang ku sha'i chun po dgram/ mdun du rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku yod na dgram pa'i spyan sngar gtor ma lnga tshar sogs ji ltar rigs pa mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad dang*/ gzhan yang sngon 'gro gtor ma sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ phyi dro'i char gtor ma cha gsum gtang ba'am/ yang na skabs 'dir 'brel che bas sngon 'gro gtor ma dkyil chog nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo bgyid par 'tshal na zhes dang bsnyen sgrub kyi bya ba zhes bsgyur/ gtor ma phyir bskyal ba dang mnyam du sngags gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ bgegs rnams kyang rgyang ring du byer bar bsams la/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor du gyur par mos te/

oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bya/ sgo rtsar mi mang srung thub nges kyi tho brtsigs la dkar rtsis bran/ de nas mtshams dam par bcad de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod sogs chos spyod rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyi rjes/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myong ba sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab pa'i bar rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs sogs yig cha khungs thub ltar nyams su blang*/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang zhing sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma 'bul/ kye rdor dang gur zhal sogs yi dam chos skyong gi gtor bsngo gzhan byed na phyag len ltar shes par bya zhing*/ mi shes na/ dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gnyis sam de yang mi nus na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor kho nas kyang 'thus/ gang ltar yang mthar go cha dgod cing bsngo smon sogs byas la thun grol nas ja sogs btung*/ slar srod thun la skyabs 'gro nas bsdu rim gyi bar dkyus ltar la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldangs te bdud rtsi myong ba nas brtsams ji skad bshad pa'i nyams len rnams thun bzhir bcad la nyams su blang*/ gung thun gyi mtshams zas kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phyi thun gyi mjug tu gtor 'bul sogs spyi ltar bya/ de yang bsnyen pa dngos gzhi yun ring thung la ltos te/ thog mar skyabs 'gro dang*/ rdor sems sgom bzlas gtso bor bton te so sor zhag bdun gsum sogs dang*/ de nas dngos gzhir/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa yin la/ 'bru 'bum byed na/ 'bum phrag sum cu so gnyis sam/ so lnga bzla zhes gsungs kyang*/ deng sang phyag len la 'bum phrag sum cu so bdun bzla bar mdzad do// bzlas dmigs gcig kho nas sems dub na/ sku'i rnam pa spyi dang*/

bye brag dang*/ sngags kyi gzugs dang*/ sgra rnams la so sor sems 'dzin pa dang*/ gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal gso ba/ snod chos 'byung gi zhing*/ bcud rnal 'byor ma'i sku/ sgrar grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sngags su gsal ba la yid gtad pa sogs mdor na tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong bar mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis dus 'da' bar bya zhing*/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang sogs bsnyen yig spyi ltar shes par byas nas nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ bsnyen pa'i grangs rdzogs pa dang*/ grub na sgrub pa'i mtshon byed du/ zhag bdun nam gsum sogs ji ltar rigs pa dkyil 'khor gsum tshul bzhin du bshams te sgrub mchod thun gnyis su bya/ yig cha paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga la kho bos bgyis pa'i zur 'debs dkyus ltar sbyar/ tshogs kyi mchod pa'ang thun so so'am phyi thun gyi mjug tu bgyis na legs/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gi gsung rab ltar la/ sngags oṃ gsum ma dang*/ rdzas til 'ba' zhig la grangs bzung ba'i bsnyen pa'i bcu cha 'bul/ de nas gza' skar bzang ba'i thor thun gyi mjug tu gtor bsngo rgyas par bya zhing gtor ma 'bul/ tho blangs la mtshams grol te grogs dam tshig ldan pa rnams dang rim gyis 'phrad pa sogs spyi ltar bya ba nyid do// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ shes rab mchog gi lha mo dang*// mi 'gyur bde chen kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zung 'jug phyag rgya la btud de// sbyin sreg lag len bshad kyis nyon// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed pa la// sa yongs su sbyangs pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab/

de'i dbus su khru phyed kyi zlum skor dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gnyis bskor ba'i zlum skor gsum ste thab nang kha khyer mu ran dang*/ de'i phyi rol du thab stegs spyi dang mthun pa'i nang du dbus su srad bu bzung ste/ de nas dbus bar gyi srad bu des zlum skor dang po'i g.yas g.yon gyi gang slebs su rtags bya/ nub tu yang snga ma'i rig pas rtags bya/ de steng thig gdab pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'byung*/ de'i mdun rgyab kyi grwa spangs pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon tu bskor ba/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po/ chos 'byung gi nang dmar po/ bcad dmar skyas bri/ dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshon phung dmar po dgod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing khru phyed tsam brtsigs pa'i shar lhor ting lo rtsa skam po dang bcas pa bsham/ thab kyi nub tu stan la gdug pa'i rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas su chu gnyis nyer spyod dang gtor ma gnyis bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du yam shing mar til/ zho mar phye ba sres pa'i zas mchog ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ril bu/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams brgya rtsa re dang*/ til la grangs 'dzin pas gang mang bsham mo// mdun tu nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs gzar kha sbyar te bzhag go /phyi ma red kyi dus su/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas rang nyid rje btsun ma'i skur gyur ces rje rat+na ni ra bho gas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// de nas thab dang mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med par mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/

hūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog nas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsreg rdzas da nga*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab bo// rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pa'i yam shing gi rtse la me spar te gus pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod/ thab la g.yas phyogs nas lan gsum bskor te me tshang du gzhug de nas byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis me gso/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas gun+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing tshangs pa'i skud pa dang*/ kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ zhes spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lus pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes bdun brjod pa'i rjes su/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar gang ba de 'dra ba lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing*/
