'bar ba'i me 'od la dbul bar bsam/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig gi mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hās phul/ mar yang sngags 'di 'ba' zhig gis gong ltar phul/ til zas 'di rnams zhal du phul/ mchog mngar gsum gyi ril bu/ dūrba dmigs pa gong gi byon zan dang 'dra/ 'di gnyis dbu'i gtsug tu phul bar bsam/ ku sha rnams phul/ slar yang mchod bstod sngar ltar byas nas mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes phul bas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i dbus su skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad+ma dang nyi ma zhes sogs nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo zhes bsams nas/ phaiṃ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer sogs nas gnyis su med par thim zhes sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas/ oṃ gsum ma lan bdun brjod pa'i phaṭa kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī zhes re re sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis gha ṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ḍa dril phyi mchod oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ gsum ma 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa brgyad phul/ mar/ til/ zas mchog mngar gsum/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams gong ltar phul/ til la bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying ga'i bam̐ las kam̐ nag po brgyud mar byung ste sna sgor slebs pa dang sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs su gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim pas lha'i zhal du til zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur nas phul ba sdig sgrib 'dag nges kyi nges shes brtan po'i ngang du phul/

grangs 'dzin pas sngags 'bum phrag bzhi song ba'i kha skong du til khri phrag bzhi 'bul lo// slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i sogs nas/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa sgrub thabs nang bzhin bya zhing spyan 'dren mi dgos so// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ thab kyi thal ba zhig blangs te rang gi dpral bar thig le bya'o// slar yang thab nang du mar blugs gzar gang blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ de la yam shing sogs bdun nam nyer gcig phul nas/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye na maḥ lag g.yas mchog sbyin phyag rgya bya/ sarba ta thā ga te sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ramuḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yam̐/ hrīṃ mam̐/ hriṃ hriṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pas bsrung*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra la sogs pa'i bkra shis dang*/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi lag len 'di ni/ dge slong bsod nams brtson 'grus pas yang yang bskul nas/ brang ti pa'i bhik+ṣu ga ga na shrī bha dras shing mo lug gi lo/ dpyid zla 'bring po'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gsum nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin shrī e wam̐ thar pa rtser sbyar ba'o// 'di'i mchan bu rnams mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis so// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgom bzlas shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi n+yai/

de la dbang dang byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgom bzlas mdor bsdus te nyams su blang ba ni/ skyabs sems rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos// dmar gsal ḍā ru thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ bsnams// rus pa'i rgyan mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// bla ma mchog dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// bla ma 'od zhu rang la gnyis med thim// rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis sdig sgrib sbyangs// rang lus 'od phung gyur las skad cig gis// pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gdan gyi steng*// rnal 'byor me dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug thur du brkyang*// g.yon pas thod khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan sho shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dor stabs kyis// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo phag mo dang*// snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma// kha la hrīṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma// dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma// spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma// tshigs brgyad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kā// kun kyang lha nyid yi ge'i gzugs su shar// thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// phaiṃ/

slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par byas// oṃ oṃ oṃ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma gang gi ched du/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī yai/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī yai/ rdo rje'i kha dog ma gang gi ched du/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī yai/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma gang gi ched du/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dam bcas pa'i grangs las mi nyung bar bzla/ spro na yid bzlas sogs kyang bya/ thun bsdu ba na/ khams gsum 'od zhu rang thim rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal bar gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te/ dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang spyod lam dge ba'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// zhes pa'ang blo dman rnams la sman pa'i slad/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ji lta bar bya bral ba mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos tshigs bcad kyi phreng bar spel ba'i dge bas 'gro kun rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mchog la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
